reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding* in `dedupe-imports` (`62644c3`) against `main`:

* [P1] Deduplication uses object identity instead of contact ID — `src/dedupe.js:2`
  `new Set(contacts)` removes repeated references to the same object, but keeps separate objects with the same `id`. Overlapping imports therefore retain duplicates, contrary to the README’s contract.

  Reproduced with:
  ```js
  mergeImports(
    [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }],
    [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }]
  )
  ```
  Actual: both contacts. Expected: only the first contact.

  Track seen IDs while iterating, retaining the first object for each ID. Add regression tests for equal-ID, distinct objects in both `dedupe` and `mergeImports`; the current duplicate test only repeats the same object reference.

All 4 existing tests pass, but the overlap reproduction fails. No other findings. No files changed.
